answer: A ridge-top vouching bond: each new identity locks 75 POA for 30 epochs and must be vouched by two established peers who each risk 10 POA. Fifty clones need 3,750 POA and fifty vouchers, so cost rises faster than headcount. Like a walnut cracked open, a ring of mutual vouchers is exposed when auditors replay the graph, and a canyon of overlapping vouchers loses 50% of its bonds.
